title: Splinter Shadow
html:
Splinter Shadow is a reaction available to  Nimbus and  Splintered Shadow Hound that allows it to create a splintered copy of itself when attacked. A version of this ability can additionally be acquired by  Accursed Spectres summoned by Hexblades if Nimbus moves within 3 m (10 ft) of them.

Description

When you are attacked by a melee attack that does not deal Radiant damage, splinter off a piece of yourself to spawn a new version from the shadows.

How to learn

Used by creatures: Nimbus, Splintered Shadow Hound, and Accursed Spectre

Notes

  • Splintered Shadow Hounds cannot be controlled by the player.
  • The same  Nimbus or  Splintered Shadow Hound can spawn multiple Splintered Shadow Hounds.
  • An attack made by a party member does not trigger this reaction.
  • When Nimbus moves within 3 m (10 ft) of an  Accursed Spectre, the spectre gains this reaction. Conversely, Nimbus gains the spectre's  Right Behind You reaction until the next long rest.
